description:
Anonymised respondent-level rows from the Male Confidence Index 2025, for your own analysis.

    Each row has row_id, the requested columns and Weight (always use it). Page with offset and
    next_offset. Rows are anonymised (no identifiers, shuffled, free text redacted).

    Args:
        columns: variable ids or question groups, e.g. ["S1", "age_group", "Q11", "Male_Confidence_Index"].
            Default: gender, age, state, index and domain scores.
        filter: optional {variable: value}, e.g. {"gender": "Male", "state": "Victoria"}.
        offset: start row (default 0).
        limit: rows per page, 1 to 200 (default 50); pages are capped at about 60kB.
        labels: true for answer labels (default), false for numeric codes (smaller; see mci_questions).
name: mci_rows
title: Male Confidence Index: respondent rows
